request.prompt: Create a NEW production sprite sheet for a high quality Korean isometric fantasy RPG normal monster GNOLL. Text-only character brief: spotted TAN HYENA gnoll, long dark muzzle, dark ears, leather chest harness and ragged brown skirt, attached long tail, ONE red-and-white round shield strapped to anatomical LEFT forearm, ONE long wood-handled iron POLEAXE held in RIGHT hand. Consistent detailed hand painted 3D rendered fantasy sprite style; full body, realistic articulated hocks/paws, clean opaque colored body on TRUE alpha transparent background. This is original art created from this brief. EXACTLY SIXTEEN separated figures in FOUR columns FOUR rows. ALL figures EAST-facing side view, nose, gaze, chest, toes toward screen RIGHT; fixed orthographic isometric camera, no camera rotation. Row1: IDLE0, IDLE1, RUN0, RUN1. Row2: RUN2, RUN3, RUN4, RUN5. Row3: ATTACK0 windup, ATTACK1 CONTACT, ATTACK2 recovery, HIT0. Row4: HIT1, DEATH0 knee buckle, DEATH1 connected side collapse, DEATH2 fully horizontal intact inert body. RUN0 right paw landing forward and left trailing, RUN1 right compressed support with left knee driving forward, RUN2 brief flight with right rear/left forward, RUN3 LEFT paw landing forward and right trailing, RUN4 LEFT compressed support with right knee driving forward, RUN5 flight with LEFT rear and RIGHT forward. The second half MUST exchange which anatomical leg bears weight. BOTH paws/hocks visible. Hips rotate, knees bend, ears/tail respond, no whole-still translations. Attack CONTACT must extend the actual blade far ahead of the muzzle toward screen RIGHT at enemy torso height, right elbow extends, visible impact lunge, left shield protects torso, no weapon behind head in contact frame. Idle breathing grounded; hit braces distinct from idle/attack. All equipment attached, grip and hand ownership constant, no detached pieces. No ground shadow, floor, grid, text, letters, smoke, effects, particles or other objects. Bodies small within each cell with extremely generous gutters, including the ENTIRE long poleaxe. No cut off limbs/weapon/tail. Each cell has one connected complete silhouette and the same anatomy scale. No image shown to chat; save result as local PNG.
